description: Canonical capability model shared by SynthesisCore providers and Flux native collectors. SynthesisCore owns this file; Flux vendors a byte-identical copy at jni/gfx/capability_schema_v4.json. Any contributor (Kotlin provider, fluxd collector) normalises its observations into these domains and keys. Collectors report observable facts only; interpretation and policy live above this layer.

conventions.absent_means: unsupported or not observed on this device
conventions.additive_only: keys and domains may be added within a schema version; removing or repurposing a key requires a schema_version bump and a migration note
conventions.provenance: each domain records the source id that populated it; a per-key override map handles domains merged from several sources

vulkan.description: Facts read from the Vulkan loader and the first physical device. Collected natively by fluxd.

gpu.description: Normalised GPU identity. Derived from Vulkan facts where available, corroborated by sysfs presence checks.

display.description: Primary display mode and colour capabilities. Best collected by a framework provider in SynthesisCore.

hwc.description: Hardware composer presence and interface generation. Presence is observable natively; version detail is best read through the framework.

renderengine.description: Observed RenderEngine and HWUI backend selection. Facts as currently configured; this layer never sets them.

runtime.description: Platform and kernel facts that gate what the graphics stack may attempt.
